Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a dedicated Seria Allen character TURNAROUND DESIGN sheet from ONLY the top-center female portrait in the supplied atlas. Ignore the five other portraits. This is a new original sprite character drawn coherently from scratch, not a recolor, pasted portrait, hat overlay, stock sprite or composite.

Empty hands resting naturally beside body, no held map or instruments, no weapons. Match portrait face and color relationships. Feminine adult proportions, not chibi.

Render each figure at exact 4x pixel magnification if a larger sheet is required. Fixed slightly elevated north-up RPG camera, not eye-level illustration. Same body/head size and foot baseline in every cell. Entire hair, hands, coat and boots contained within generous empty gutters. No cropping. Do not add a ninth figure.
